description: This Java source file defines the MrpServices class, providing various static methods to support Manufacturing Resource Planning (MRP) operations in the Apache OFBiz framework. The class includes methods for initializing MRP events, calculating product quantities on hand, processing Bill of Materials components, and executing the MRP logic, which involves collecting demand data, managing inventory, and planning procurements or manufacturing orders.

classes.name: MrpServices
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for handling Manufacturing Resource Planning (MRP) operations such as initializing events, calculating stock, processing BOM components, and orchestrating the planning process in the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: initMrpEvents
methods.description: Initializes or resets MRP events by clearing existing data and loading current order, requirement, and forecast data to prepare for new MRP run.

methods.name: findProductMrpQoh
methods.description: Calculates the quantity on hand (QOH) of a specified product for MRP, optionally within a specific facility.

methods.name: logMrpError
methods.description: Logs an error or exception related to MRP activities into the MrpEvent entity for tracking and diagnostics.

methods.name: executeMrp
methods.description: Performs the core MRP process by calculating demands, stock levels, and planning procurement or manufacturing orders based on current inventory, requirements, and forecasts.

methods.name: processBomComponent
methods.description: Processes a BOM (Bill of Materials) for a product, inserting component requirements into the MRP system, respecting product activity status and routing.
